title: Defect Triage: Prioritize Bugs Like a Pro

scenes.line1: How do teams decide which bugs to fix first?
scenes.say: Ever wonder how teams choose which bugs get fixed right away and which can wait? Let’s break down the defect triage process.

scenes.label: Review
scenes.sub: Teams review reported bugs together, weighing impact.
scenes.say: Defect triage means reviewing new bugs as a team, looking at how they affect users and the business.

rows.b: How soon should we fix it?
Who will fix or track it?

scenes.say: First, review the defect. Then, set severity for impact, priority for urgency, and assign someone to handle it.
Severity is about how much damage a bug causes. Priority is about how quickly it needs fixing. A crash is high severity and usually high priority.

scenes.question: What’s more important: severity or priority?
scenes.right: Priority decides fix order, even if severity is high.
scenes.say: Don’t assume high severity always comes first. Priority sets the order, so business needs can shift focus.
